gen-gf-duru-sans-fs-karma: Karma reads tight and tidy, its terminals stopping short of the stems. Over a long page its restrained modulation never snags the eye, while Duru Sans leads with swollen, rope-like lowercase and an unclenched c.
gen-gf-epunda-sans-fs-erode: Dignified is the first word for Erode, though Epunda Sans stands up front with wide-mouthed rounds and a towering midzone. Erode then takes over with its tall middle band and gently ebbing strokes, where the heading is the one that sits tightly packed.
gen-gf-epunda-sans-fs-karma: Trustworthy comes through in Karma, with its low gap between x-height and capitals. And Epunda Sans, wide-mouthed and tightly spaced up top, hands over to a body whose modulation stays moderate enough to carry a long page without a jolt.
gen-gf-epunda-slab-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Dignified slab letters lead the way here. Be Vietnam Pro brings the strongest quality: strokes like bent steel rod, with curve endings that stay well apart beneath Epunda Slab's generous c.
gen-gf-epunda-slab-fs-merriweather-sans: Big lowercase, traditional bones: Epunda Slab sets the tone with a generous c. Merriweather Sans follows with sturdy, tall letters and an e whose eye opens clearly, so a long stretch of text keeps its footing.
gen-gf-esteban-archivo: Archivo reads big and forthright, its curves opening outward. Esteban brings a bookish tall middle zone and slightly thinner curves on top, and the sturdy body below lets that refinement stay readable.
gen-gf-esteban-fs-asap: Esteban leads with a bookish tall middle zone and gently ebbing stroke weight, giving headings a refined voice. Asap does the plain work, with open arcs and near-capital body height.
gen-gf-esteban-fs-epilogue: Epilogue is curvy and unclamped, with stubby ascender tips. Across a long stretch its wire-like monoline skeleton keeps a quiet, level beat, while Esteban's visible stroke variation handles the headline flair.
gen-gf-esteban-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans brings a larger-than-usual x-height and s curves that open wide at both ends, with no swelling at all. But Esteban's stems, a little heavier than its hairlines, add the bookish touch that keeps the pair from feeling flat.
gen-gf-esteban-fs-public-sans: Hefty lowercase, broad counters: Public Sans comes across sturdy. Across a long passage it keeps trustworthy and steady, while Esteban's slight but noticeable stroke contrast adds a refined, bookish hint up top.
